Verdict.Summary: The implemented code (Domain 1, Domain 2.fs, Domain 5) is internally coherent at the static level: the import DAG has zero violations, static Task invariants are enforced at TaskMetadata construction, and the RPC/lifecycle/event contracts match their execution/*.md specs nearly 1:1. It is NOT fully self-consistent at three levels: (1) documentation (ROADMAP names, stale sub_module_design/runtime.md, Wave-1 plan vs reality), (2) architectural seams for the not-yet-built domains (ModuleProviderPort DTO ownership breaks the future DAG; ports satisfied only by test doubles), and (3) a set of behavioural contradictions against stated guarantees (P3 never-rerun, detached spawn, fatal-vs-contention lock errors, cross-process reentrancy deadlock).

Findings.Finding: Cross-process SERIALIZE reentrancy can deadlock: A holds res_K and calls daemon B; in B an unrelated holder C already polls A's lock without deadline; A's legal reentrant descendant W is queued behind C (C→A→W→C). Cross-proc check validates legality but never lets W bypass the queue.

ModuleProviderPort returns execution-owned DTOs (ModuleDescriptor, TaskRouteSpec, ...). The future providers (packaging, metadata) are forbidden to import execution, so the port cannot be implemented without an unspecified adapter in execution/surface. Today only the test performs this translation.

spawn_detached is not uniformly detached: inherits _YSCB_TREE_ID (Linux env-token sweep kills it); on Windows Job lacks BREAKAWAY_OK so fallback stays in job; macOS survives. A daemon spawned from a managed child dies on Linux/Windows but not macOS.

Stale sub_module_design/runtime.md (L0-L5 model, core/runtime/, forbids rpc/lifecycle, entities InvocationEnvelope/ ExecutionOutcome/RuntimeEngine) directly contradicts execution/runtime.md and code; unguarded by Gate 0 parity.

Wave-1 plan (all specs + blind review first, Domain 1→6 bottom-up, per-domain unplug tests) contradicts reality: D5 fully built, D1/D2 built without specs, D3/D4/D6 absent, only monolithic live suite.

P3 never-rerun is only client-observed: CALL_ACCEPTED flushed but unread, or handler side-effects before ack then raise, yields was_accepted=False → transparent retry. Requires an 'ack before side effects' rule that is not specified.
Handshake is not mutual (server proves nothing beyond echoing boot_id); spec claims two-way verification.

Daemon trusts client-supplied approval_scope/call_stack/lineage/hot_workspaces; any token holder can assert GATED approval. Acceptable only if approval_scope is declared a UX gate, not a security boundary — undocumented.
CONDITIONAL not tightened on event chains / cross-ws (allow_conditional defaults True); only GATED is.
A HYBRID parent may nested-call a mutation task when running cold but is rejected when hot — outcome depends on daemon state.
Child dispatcher re-binds shared coordinators on every delegation without a lock.
Tier-0 work (steps, equivalence_fn, mappers) cannot be killed; hot resource lock held until thread exits; Tier-0 equivalence/mapper have no timeout.
Primary timeout_ms bounds the whole turn including deferred subscribers; undocumented.
OneShotVenvHost keys handles by group only ('per-Turn' docstring); concurrent cold turns share a worker and one turn's teardown kills it.
Late-elevated followers never speed the shared flight; leader's external priority handle leaks elevation; PREEMPT cancels all COALESCE participants.
ProtectedModuleLoader monkey-patches process-global importlib.import_module (contradicts DR-05 'zero global singletons').
Cross-workspace join cycle check fails open when remote daemon is unreachable (blocks ≤1.5s per ancestor).
Lock upgrade timeout/displacement raises ILLEGAL_LOCK_REENTRANCY (fatal turn code) — contention aborts turns; lock I/O faults mapped to DAEMON_UNAVAILABLE (masked as transient quiesce).
FileLock cancellation raises YscbError(TASK_CANCELLED) not TaskCancelledException.
Two shared holders upgrading with timeout=None deadlock; no fairness (pure polling).
Symlink rejection largely defeated by HostPath realpath at construction; path-based check-then-act races (no dirfd/openat).
fsync errors swallowed, parent dir never fsynced after replace, file mode lost when file_mode=None.
read_live_owner_dict checks pid liveness without start-time fingerprint (PID reuse keeps dead owner live).
UNORDERED fold anchors at first occurrence across intervening ORDERED envelopes; event.md contradicts itself (preserve boundaries vs anchor-first).
Empty workspace_scope acts as undocumented wildcard; omitted scope makes cross-workspace same-EventId emissions conflict.
execute_turn vs execute_event_turn report fatal errors differently.
warmup/drain race: resources pushed after close_all_lifo never closed (no closed flag); concurrent warmup() can mark READY early.
Container state has two sources of truth (lifecycle _state + daemon _phase).
Periodic/background/bg-invoke failures silently dropped (no logger yet) — AGENTS anti-pattern #1.
No default Idle TTL; daemon never idles out unless overridden.
Gate 0 is a denylist, does not audit module templates for DR-05 bans / sdk-only imports; dev check 2.0 absent.

~15 suites named 'orphan / backup / failover / adoption' test emergent behaviour of symmetric COALESCE flights; no such concepts exist in kernel vocabulary or specs — test naming diverged from design vocabulary.

Recommendations.Step: Archive or delete sub_module_design/runtime.md; extend Gate 0 parity to fail on orphan spec files.
Amend ROADMAP Wave 1: declare execution a provisional spike, require port re-review once D2.vfs/space, D3, D4, D6 specs exist; reconcile NamingMap.
Decide ModuleProviderPort DTO ownership (move route/descriptor VOs down to foundation/metadata, or spec an execution/surface adapter) before writing D3/D4 specs.
Write the RPC trust model: ack-before-side-effects rule for NON_IDEMPOTENT tasks, whether approval_scope is a security boundary, mutual auth.
Fix lock layer: cross-proc reentrant descendant bypass, upgrade deadlock, non-fatal error code for contention, TaskCancelledException.
Make spawn_detached uniform: strip _YSCB_TREE_ID, set JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_BREAKAWAY_OK or fail loudly.
Single source of truth for container state; closed-flag on LifoResourceStack; diagnostics for background failures; default Idle TTL.
Clarify gate/timeout/event-ordering semantics in specs, then align code.
Turn Gate 0 DAG into an allowlist, add downstream-module audit, rename suites to kernel vocabulary, add per-domain unplug tests.
